units.function: Doctor check that reports whether one Agent JWT signing Secret is loaded from process environment, merely present in the resolved env file, or absent; repair creates/persists a value through the config env helper.
units.dependencyDirection: The check depends on CLI env/config helpers for resolution, reading and creation and returns the generic CheckResult used by doctor. It does not parse JWTs or verify server/Agent exchange behavior.
units.keyDataModels: One PAPERCLIP_AGENT_JWT_SECRET string, resolved env-file path and CheckResult pass/warn/fail/canRepair/repairHint.
units.lifecycle: Check loaded environment first; if absent inspect env file; pass when loaded, warn when persisted but unloaded, fail and offer repair when missing; repair generates/writes the Secret.
units.testAssessment: The previously audited focused agent-jwt-env suite was reused rather than reread and passed 6/6 on 2026-08-19; CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. Coverage proves precedence, file discovery/generation and doctor statuses, but not entropy/length, file permissions, rotation, issuer/audience, multi-instance isolation, JWT verification, compromise recovery or concurrent repair.
units.designRationale: Prevent Agent authentication from starting with an absent signing key and offer a simple local-development repair path while distinguishing persisted configuration from the current process environment.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs runtime identity and attestation across independent cloud/local execution nodes without sharing one long-lived signing Secret or conflating Agent credentials with human IdentityPort sessions.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT the identity mechanism. ADAPT only the explicit doctor pass/warn/fail/repair pattern. Use asymmetric or managed issuer keys, per-deployment/node key identity, audience/subject/capability-bound short-lived tokens, rotation/JWKS overlap, revocation and hardware/Secret-provider storage. Repair must enroll or rotate through an authorized Identity/Execution Node workflow, not silently create a shared file Secret.
units.responsibilityConflict: Possession of a shared JWT signing Secret can mint arbitrary Agent identities and therefore undermines reliable executor attribution. Company OS runtime proof must bind a Connector/node/key version and Work authorization, not merely validate a token signed by one copied secret.

securityFindings: Any non-empty environment value produces pass; entropy, minimum length, known/default values, encoding, expiry and key version are not checked.
The model uses one symmetric signing Secret whose copying into worktrees was independently observed, enabling cross-environment token forgery and trust-domain cloning.
Repair writes a Secret file but this unit does not verify exclusive creation, mode/owner, symlink defenses, atomicity, backup exclusion or secure deletion.
No issuer, audience, subject, tenant, Connector/node, capability or Work binding is checked by this diagnostic.
No rotation age, current/previous key overlap, revocation, compromise indicator or multi-key health is reported.
Messages reveal the resolved env-file path; acceptable for local doctor output only under authorized operator access and path-redaction policy.
